arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Unikowsky argued the Act does not authorize dividing waived military pay.
Mr. Wirken argued state authority to treat pay as property operates at divorce.
Ms. Eisenstein addressed concerns about the effect of prior precedent on the proposed rule.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of the Former Spouses Protection Act. It asks if state courts can divide military retirement pay as property during divorce.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: the side that brought the case wants the Court to limit state court authority over military retirement pay.
